ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the horizontal axis is 1969–2004, the left vertical axis is the flood disaster complexity index, and the right vertical axis is the average disaster-affected area; the solid line represents the complexity index, and the dashed line represents the average disaster-affected area. It can be seen in the figure that after the 1990s, the average disaster-affected area of H Province expanded obviously and rapidly, and the flood disaster complexity index also changed significantly. Reasoning: The rapid expansion of the disaster-affected area of flood disasters in a relatively short period indicates that the formation of floods and their range of influence increased. Combined with the formation mechanism of flood disasters, the most direct and main natural cause is usually concentrated rainstorms and high precipitation intensity, causing surface runoff to increase rapidly and triggering flood disasters. Therefore, the main cause of flood disasters in H Province is high precipitation intensity.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中的变量和趋势：1990年代后H省洪灾平均受灾面积快速扩大，复杂度指数也随之明显变化，表明洪涝灾害强度和影响范围加大。再结合洪涝形成机理判断，能在较短时期内直接造成大面积洪灾的首要自然因素是强降水或暴雨集中。因此把主要原因确定为“降水强度大”。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中横轴为1969—2004年，左纵轴为洪涝灾害复杂度指数，右纵轴为平均受灾面积；实线表示复杂度指数，虚线表示平均受灾面积。图中可见，20世纪90年代以后，H省平均受灾面积明显、快速扩大，洪涝灾害复杂度指数也发生显著变化。推理：洪涝灾害受灾面积在较短时期内迅速扩大，说明洪水形成和影响范围加大。结合洪涝灾害形成机理，最直接、最主要的自然原因通常是暴雨集中、降水强度大，导致地表径流迅速增加并引发洪涝。因此，造成H省洪涝灾害的主要原因是降水强度大。

raw_record.original_question:
下图为1969—2004年我国东部H省洪灾面积和洪涝灾害复杂度指数变化图。读图并结合所学知识回答：造成H省洪涝灾害的主要原因是什么？

<image1>
raw_record.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the horizontal axis is 1969–2004, the left vertical axis is the flood disaster complexity index, and the right vertical axis is the average disaster-affected area; the solid line represents the complexity index, and the dashed line represents the average disaster-affected area. It can be seen in the figure that after the 1990s, the average disaster-affected area of H Province expanded obviously and rapidly, and the flood disaster complexity index also changed significantly. Reasoning: The rapid expansion of the disaster-affected area of flood disasters in a relatively short period indicates that the formation of floods and their range of influence increased. Combined with the formation mechanism of flood disasters, the most direct and main natural cause is usually concentrated rainstorms and high precipitation intensity, causing surface runoff to increase rapidly and triggering flood disasters. Therefore, the main cause of flood disasters in H Province is high precipitation intensity.
